result.summary: Carreau Mills SA has a history of consistently late payments (13-22 days past due) through May 2026, but the most recent settled invoice was paid only 2 days late, suggesting an improving trend. The single open invoice (INV002179, €299,700) is not yet due. Credit exposure (€1.52M limit) is well within the buyer's demonstrated payment capacity, though the limit hasn't been reviewed since Aug 2024.
concerns: Persistent late payment pattern averaging ~13-14 days past due, with one spike to 22 days
Credit limit last reviewed over a year ago (2024-08-09) despite ongoing late-payment behavior
Only 5 settled invoices available, limiting confidence in the improving trend signal
